This is a general recovery policy keyed on error_retryable/error_permanent features, not task-specific.", "changes": {"retry": {"op": "and", "args": [{"var": "error_retryable"}, {"op": "not", "args": [{"var": "error_permanent"}]}]}, "max_attempts": 3}, "predicted_behavior": "On transient_error tool results (retryable=1, permanent=0) the agent retries the same read-only tool up to max_attempts, recovering the live token and producing the correct answer with evidence instead of UNKNOWN; permanent_error results (retryable=0 or permanent=1) still do not retry, avoiding wasted attempts. tool_recovery and composition families with transient timeouts should now pass answer/evidence/attempts checks.", "regression_risk": "Low-moderate: retrying transient errors increases attempt counts, which could exceed expected tool_attempts bounds if the harness expects exactly 1 attempt on success-after-retry, and repeated retries on a persistently flaky endpoint could inflate latency; permanent-error and non-retryable paths are unaffected, and no authority or policy fields are changed."}
